etymologies.etymologyHTML: Learned borrowing from Latin nūtrīcius.

definitions.definition: (of food or drink) Providing nutrients; healthy to eat.

quote.citation: 1861, Isaac Taylor, The Spirit of the Hebrew Poetry, page 247:
quote.text: A cumbrous, circuitous, and often a sophisticative mode of commenting upon the Prophets, and of darkening their meaning, had taken the place of what might have been a nutritious popular instruction.
